parameters_passed_to_the_agent.search_scope: Business subsidies run by the Samenwerkingsverband Noord-Nederland (SNN, the joint body of the provinces of Groningen, Fryslan and Drenthe) that are open or about to open and fund innovation, research and development, energy, sustainability, hydrogen, grid congestion, industry or digitalisation in Northern Netherlands. This covers the EFRO (European Regional Development Fund) programme Noord-Nederland 2021-2027, the JTF (Just Transition Fund) programme for Groningen-Emmen, the MIT regional schemes, and provincial schemes SNN runs, such as those of the Nationaal Programma Groningen (NPG). Each scheme page (www.snn.nl/zakelijke-subsidies/<scheme>) is one FO; a scheme whose page or regulation sets up separate parts, each with its own budget, rate and applicants, gives one FO per part. Skip schemes for private individuals and housing (insulation, Nij Begun, earthquake reinforcement and 'Verduurzaming en verbetering' schemes, asbestos roofs), agriculture and rural schemes (GLB, LEADER, EIP, wolf fences, Kennisverspreiding landbouw), liveability and community budgets (Impulsloket, Inwonersbudget), labour-market and training schemes (NPG Personeel en scholing, Arbeidsmarkttransitie JTF), loans, and small advice or feasibility vouchers that only pay for external consultancy for one SME (Adviesvoucherregeling Fryslan, Mkb haalbaarheidsvoucher).
parameters_passed_to_the_agent.navigation_instructions: 1. Open the starting URL. A plain page fetch works; no browser is needed. 2. The list shows only open and soon-closing schemes by default ('Toon gesloten: Nee'). It holds about 34 schemes on four pages: add ?page=1, ?page=2 and ?page=3 to the URL for pages 2 to 4. Each entry shows the title, the status ('Open' or 'Sluit binnenkort'), the provinces and 'Aanvragen mogelijk t/m <date>'. Screen every entry by title and short description against the search scope. On 17 November 2026 the in-scope schemes were, in list order: Valorisatie 2026; Slimme energiesystemen en duurzame energie; Een nieuwe, groene economie met marktgedreven onderzoeks- en investeringsprojecten (JTF); Waterstof kennisontwikkeling en innovatie (NPG); Ontwikkeling waterstofketens (NPG); Subsidie VIA Groningen 2025-2026 (JTF); Subsidieregeling netcongestie (NPG); Subsidie Investeren in Toekomstbestendige Industrie 2025 (NPG). 3. Open each in-scope scheme page. Its header gives the maximum amount, the remaining budget, the subsidy rate and the closing date and time; the sections 'Voor wie is deze subsidie?', 'Waarvoor kun je subsidie krijgen?' and 'Wat zijn de voorwaarden?' give eligibility and conditions. The tabs 'Aanvraag voorbereiden' (required documents and formats) and 'Veelgestelde vragen' (FAQ) are sub-pages at <scheme>/aanvraag-voorbereiden and <scheme>/veelgestelde-vragen. 4. The authoritative text is the regulation PDF linked on the scheme page under 'Uitvoeringsregeling', 'Documenten', 'Regeling en toelichting' or 'JTF-regelgeving' (files under www.snn.nl/sites/default/files/documents/). EFRO schemes have an Uitvoeringsregeling; JTF schemes have a chapter of the JTF-regeling 2021-2027 (chapter 1 holds the general rules, chapter 2.x the scheme); NPG and other provincial schemes have a provincial Subsidieregeling published in the Provinciaal blad. 5. Several schemes need a mandatory first step before the application, such as a 2-page project proposal (Valorisatie) or an intake talk with the province (JTF); the scheme page and regulation state it. 6. The pages and regulations are in Dutch; www.snn.nl/en has only general English information.
parameters_passed_to_the_agent.link_scope: Scheme pages and their sub-pages under www.snn.nl/zakelijke-subsidies/, SNN knowledge-base pages they link to for the application process (for example the 2-page project proposal page), and the regulation and annex documents under www.snn.nl/sites/default/files/documents/. Also the official publications of those regulations on zoek.officielebekendmakingen.nl and wetten.overheid.nl. Do not follow links to the eLoket, EFRO, JTF, GLB or REP web portals, login pages, news, events, 'Raak geinspireerd' project stories, the private-individuals section (subsidies-voor-particulieren) or external organisations' websites.
parameters_passed_to_the_agent.completion_rules: The run is complete when every entry on all four pages of the business list has been screened and every in-scope scheme page, with its regulation, has been opened. If the run reaches the cap of 5 new candidates first, stop there: later runs skip the schemes already recorded and find the rest, starting with the next in-scope scheme in list order. A run that screens everything and finds no new in-scope scheme ends with no new FO.
